assumptions: 36.7% annual JOLTS manufacturing separations proxy new exposed workers.
36% of exposed workers receive periodic exams; referrals.26% of those.

reconstruction_issues: Medical services CPI used to update monitoring sampler price without economic justification.
High-authority CBP growth does not independently validate inherited exposed-worker shares.
methods_worth_testing: Preserve SOC codes, wage share and industry-specific population updates.
Separate worker examination time from purchased physician services.
